protocol.selected_scope: Level 5 downsampling only; 9 output positions; original weights, upsampling, decoder and other levels unchanged
protocol.selection: On first 128 hard validation solutions, exclude native/sham/fixed_bias. Require no introduced exact reconstruction failures vs native and higher positional code entropy. Maximize positional entropy, then minimize RMS quantizer-input change, then lexical name. If none qualifies, select highest entropy as diagnostic only and explicitly reject a free repair claim.
protocol.replication: Selected variant and native on 600 easy and medium test solutions with shared solution families
protocol.limits: Exploratory intervention prompted by prior inspected Sudoku results. Reconstruction uses known solutions, not solving puzzles. Increased variance or occupancy is not improved task robustness. Generator encoder-pool changes can be inactive at inference.
